content.title: Shrinking - Season 3 (2026) Apple TV Review
content.text: With Alice leaving for college, Paul’s Parkinsons continuing to affect his practice, Gaby experiencing confidence-shaking revelations, Liz and Derek attempting to cut the umbilical cord with their adult kids, Brian and Charlie progressing on their fatherhood journey, and Sean making massive strides, Jimmy has to now deal with his own growth and decide if he can move forward amidst all the upheaval of change. Season 3 of Apple TV’s Shrinking is all about change… not that the rest of the show hasn’t been… but now we watch Jimmy, Paul, Gaby, Alice, and the rest grapple with what life looks like as their lives move forward.
